start.title: The Wilderness of Sin
start.text:
Weeks since the sea. Bread is gone.
The people murmur behind you.

choices.text: Silence them with anger
choices.feedback: Their hunger is real.

choices.text: Listen to their cry, then seek God
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:3 — The people of Israel complained to Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.

choices.text: Promise them food you do not have
choices.feedback: Only the Lord can promise that.

anger_consequence.title: Hear Them First
anger_consequence.text:
A leader hears before he speaks.
Their hunger is not rebellion alone.

choices.text: Listen to their cry, then seek God
choices.feedback: Your face softens.

lie_consequence.title: Speak Only Truth
lie_consequence.text:
Empty promises will break them.
Go to the One who fills hands.

choices.text: Listen to their cry, then seek God
choices.feedback: You take their words to heaven.

people_complain.title: "Better in Egypt"
people_complain.text:
"We had pots of meat there!"
Their eyes look back, not forward.

choices.text: Agree and turn back to Egypt
choices.feedback: He did not free you for chains.

choices.text: Carry their cry to the Lord
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:12 — The Lord heard the grumbling of the people of Israel.

turnback_consequence.title: Never Backward
turnback_consequence.text:
The Lord leads forward, always.
Bring their hunger to Him.

choices.text: Carry their cry to the Lord
choices.feedback: You lift your eyes upward.

moses_seeks_god.title: Alone Before Him
moses_seeks_god.text:
Twilight falls on the silent hill.
You wait for His voice.

choices.text: Demand bread as your right
choices.feedback: Bread is His gift, not your wage.

choices.text: Blame yourself and lose hope
choices.feedback: He has not forgotten you.

choices.text: Lay their hunger before Him
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:12 — The Lord told Moses that He had heard the grumbling of the people of Israel.

demand_consequence.title: He Gives, You Receive
demand_consequence.text:
Bread falls only from open hands.
Kneel and ask, do not demand.

choices.text: Lay their hunger before Him
choices.feedback: You bow your head.

despair_consequence.title: He Hears You
despair_consequence.text:
Your weakness is not the end.
His mercy is just beginning.

choices.text: Lay their hunger before Him
choices.feedback: You speak the people's pain.

god_speaks.title: "I Will Rain Bread"
god_speaks.text:
His voice fills the still desert:
"Bread from heaven, day by day."

choices.text: Hide the promise from the people
choices.feedback: His word is for them too.

choices.text: Tell Aaron and the people at once
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:10 — As Aaron spoke to the whole Israelite community, they looked toward the desert, and there was the glory of the Lord appearing in the cloud.

hide_consequence.title: Speak the Promise
hide_consequence.text:
Hope shared is hope doubled.
Go, tell what you have heard.

choices.text: Tell Aaron and the people at once
choices.feedback: You run to the camp.

tell_people.title: Word to the Camp
tell_people.text:
Aaron stands ready beside you.
The weary lift their faces.

choices.text: Boast you brought the answer
choices.feedback: It is the Lord, not you.

choices.text: Give the Lord all the glory
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:8 — Moses told the people that the Lord would give them meat to eat in the evening and bread in the morning.

choices.text: Tell only the elders, not the rest
choices.feedback: His promise is for all Israel.

boast_consequence.title: His Glory, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
The bread is from heaven, not you.
Let His name be lifted high.

choices.text: Give the Lord all the glory
choices.feedback: Heads bow with yours.

secret_consequence.title: All Must Hear
secret_consequence.text:
Every tent must know His mercy.
Speak openly to the camp.

choices.text: Give the Lord all the glory
choices.feedback: The whole camp listens.

manna_falls.title: Bread from Heaven
manna_falls.text:
At dawn, white flakes lie like dew.
The ground is covered in mercy.

choices.text: Forbid the people to gather
choices.feedback: It is given to be eaten.

choices.text: Tell each to gather one omer a day
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:16 — Moses commanded them to gather as much as each one needed, an omer for each person.

forbid_consequence.title: Receive His Gift
forbid_consequence.text:
He sent it for their hands.
Let them gather and live.

choices.text: Tell each to gather one omer a day
choices.feedback: You wave them forward.

gather_daily.title: An Omer a Day
gather_daily.text:
Some hands tremble with fear:
"What of tomorrow's hunger?"

choices.text: Let them store extra in jars
choices.feedback: He provides each new day.

choices.text: Teach them: trust Him each morning
choices.feedback: Exodus 16:19 — Moses told them that no one was to keep any of it until morning.

choices.text: Take a double share for yourself
choices.feedback: A leader takes only his omer.

hoarding_consequence.title: Worms by Morning
hoarding_consequence.text:
Stored manna stinks at sunrise.
Fear cannot keep His gift fresh.

choices.text: Teach them: trust Him each morning
choices.feedback: You lift the lesson before all.

selfish_consequence.title: One Omer for All
selfish_consequence.text:
A shepherd does not feast alone.
Share what He gives, in measure.

choices.text: Teach them: trust Him each morning
choices.feedback: You set down the extra.

next_morning.title: Mercy at Dawn
next_morning.text:
Again the white flakes lie waiting.
Again Israel eats and lives.

choices.text: Lead the people in quiet thanks
choices.feedback: Aaron lifts his hands with yours.

ending.title: Daily Bread
ending.text:
Day by day He fed them all.
Each morning, mercy from heaven.
